approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued accuracy across RFI, Submittal and email content.
notes: Prune ineligible workflow evidence from mixed-source candidates instead of deleting a candidate that still has valid direct evidence.
Determine conditional workflow-source labeling from every remaining direct citation, never only the first evidence ID.
title: Mixed workflow-source evidence accuracy
objective: Prevent rejected Submittal, RFI-question, email-header and quoted-history evidence from remaining as direct support when a candidate also has valid evidence, while preserving the valid candidate and labeling all remaining workflow-source conditions.
